t.zh: 板每一拍从头算起，算完什么也不留：上一拍的项，这一拍已经无从知道。
t.en: The board starts from scratch every tick and keeps nothing afterwards: this tick, the term from the tick before is gone.

t.zh: 要把一个数留到下一拍，需要一对新元件：<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把接入的数存进寄存卡，<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>从下一拍起读出它；还没有存过的时候，读出的是它的初值。
t.en: Keeping a number for the next tick takes a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores what reaches it in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out from the next tick on; before anything is stored, it reads out its start value.

after.zh: aₙ₋₁ 也是一个数列：原数列整体晚一项，开头由初值补上。
after.en: aₙ₋₁ is a sequence too: the original one a term late, its first place filled by the start value.

brief.zh: 每一拍交出输入上一拍的项；第一拍交出 0。
brief.en: Each tick give the input’s term from the tick before; give 0 on the first tick.

hint.zh: 同名的两件寄存卡元件读写的是同一张寄存卡。
hint.en: Two register parts with the same name read and write the same register.
